using namespace std;

#define ll long long

#define S second
#define mp make_pair

#define vi vector<int>
#define pq priority_queue
#define pb push_back
#define watch(x) cout << (#x) << " is " << (x) << endl

#define FOR(x,to) for(ll x=0;x<(to);x++)

#define fastio ios::sync_with_stdio(0); cin.tie(NULL);
const int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;
const int MOD = 1e9+7;

ll power_mod(ll base, ll exp){
    if(exp==0) return 1;
    ll result = power_mod(base, exp/2);
    result = (result * result) % MOD;
    if(exp % 2) {
        result = (result * base) % MOD;
    }
    return result;
}

int main(){

    cin >> p >> k;

    if(k == 0){
        cout << power_mod(p, p-1) << "\n";
    }
    else if(k == 1){
        cout << power_mod(p, p) << "\n";
    }
    else{
        ll current = k;
        ll count = 1;
        while(current != 1){

            count++;
